name: fillet-variable-fail-closed
description: K-S1 silent-wrongness regression: a variable-radius fillet of r=50 on a 10 mm box must be a typed refusal (on pre-fix main it returned a new handle measuring 3242.011 mm^3 — success with the volume growing), the refusal must leave the input measuring exactly 1000 mm^3, and the same call at a supported radius must still produce a new solid removing the closed-form sliver ((1-pi/4)*r^2*L = 2.146 mm^3). The successful fillet lands on handle 2, not 1: the refused attempt's arena slots are retired permanently and never reissued to a later entity.
